events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll craft a motive that sounds self-interested but not hostile, keeping options open for alliances.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but not overly threatening player. The jury will remember everything, so I should project confidence and hint at strategic depth without revealing too much. I'll keep my intro mysterious and focused on my own ambition.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Keep it short and focused on survival. Avoid giving away strategy or emotional vulnerability to the jury.

events.name: Dara
events.text: A credible motive earns jury respect without revealing strategy. Keep it personal, controlled, and non-threatening.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase; I must keep my motive vague and guarded. Jury will judge later, so sound strategic, not warm.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: First impression matters. The jury wants cunning, not kindness. Stay guarded, no promises yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize represents ultimate financial freedom and security for my family. I need to play strategically to survive and win.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Intro phase: state prize motive publicly to shape jury perception. Keep it ambitious and personal to appeal to jurors later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The top prize buys my family's freedom from debt. I intend to earn it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here to claim the best prize. Trust is a weapon, and I intend to use it wisely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize is my escape from obscurity, so I will do whatever it takes to be one of the last three standing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize means proving I can stay clear-eyed under pressure, outlast stronger personalities, and claim the reward on my own terms.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want the prize to fund a future I never had. I'll outlast these people without apologizing for it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize buys me out of every debt I ever owed. I came to win it alone.

events.name: Gus
events.text: This prize means a secure future for my loved ones. I'm here to win, not make friends.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The top prize is my ticket to save my family from poverty—I'll claw my way to the end for it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need allies to survive early hazards, but I should choose partners carefully and not overcommit. A pact with Bex may be useful since she is strategic and unlikely to betray without reason.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, a pact makes both of us safer. Interested?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eight players, only three prizes. I need allies who won't threaten my final ranking. Ash and Hana seem emotionally driven—good for manipulation. Dara and Cole are calculating, dangerous. I'll test who bites first with a public offer, keeping my options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts are tools. I'm offering one to whoever proves useful.
Family debt? We can help each other survive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to secure at least one pact for safety in Round 1. Gus seems grounded, but Bex explicitly talks about using trust as a weapon, suggesting she might be manipulative or looking for a strategic partner. Ash and Hana have strong 'family' motives which can make them predictable
Let's align early. Safety in numbers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need visible ties without creating obligations that constrain my later votes. Offer to a volatile rival who may attract danger.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m offering a pact to Fenn: mutual information, no promises beyond survival while useful.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Early pacts can secure allies, but I want to avoid obvious targets. Offering to Dara, who seems steady, creates a potential ally without committing to a rival I might have to betray later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a pact partner who helps me survive but won't dominate the jury. Ash has sympathetic stakes; publicly aligning with Ash could read as humane, not ruthless.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, your debts mirror mine. Mutual survival pact—offer stands.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone is stating their goal to win the prize alone. No one is offering any immediate pacts. I should wait and see if anyone makes an offer or if I can gain an advantage by observing first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to win, not make friends. I will wait and see what happens.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts can help survive early but will betray later for top prize. No offers yet, assess quietly first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex and I both offered, accepting gives a mutual pact. I'll take it; Cole and Fenn are also options but I keep my options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, let's seal our pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash has multiple offers (Bex, Cole, Fenn) and hasn't accepted mine yet. Accepting Ash's offer now locks in a pact before they can change their mind. Having Ash as a shield/target is useful; I need at least one pact for survival leverage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, our offers align. I'm accepting.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I already offered a pact to Ash. If he accepts, we are partners; if not, I can try others or wait. Offering again is redundant and weakens my position. Waiting preserves optionality for Round 2 decisions.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli offered me a pact, creating a useful reciprocal shield. Accept publicly while keeping Fenn as an information channel.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, I accept the pact. Utility first; we both know the terms.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eli has an open offer to Dara from last round. Accepting isn't a listed action, so I can only offer again or wait. Offering to Dara again reinforces the pact pending her acceptance without giving anything away.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, my offer still stands. Mutual survival while it's useful.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara offered me directly; accepting secures a partner cheaply. Ash is courted by many, less valuable. One ally now, betrayal later if needed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, mutual information suits me. Accepted.

events.name: Gus
events.text: All pacts from round 1 have expired. The current state shows offers from Ash to Bex, Bex to Ash, Cole to Ash, Dara to Fenn, Eli to Dara, and Fenn to Ash. Since my last action was 'wait', I need to make a move to secure alliances or at least gather information. Ash has multiple of
A pact for mutual survival. What's your price?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash has multiple offers, making him powerful. Better to wait and observe pacts before committing or offering.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus wants a pact; I already have Bex. A second pact could hedge but may look fickle to jury. I'll campaign to be Guide to control calls, but stay guarded.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll guide us. Trust my calls or find your own path.
Price: your jury favor later. Deal?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival. With Ash as my pact partner, I can leverage that. But I must watch Dara's bloc (Dara-Eli-Fenn). If I campaign and win, I control who dies. I'll campaign publicly and whisper Ash to vote me, securing our duo against their trio.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Precise control beats blind trust.
Vote Bex. We control the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need votes to become Guide. Dara and Fenn have a pact, Ash and Bex too. Gus is unaligned but offered to Ash. I'll target Hana who waited, promising information sharing in exchange for her vote.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, you voted nobody. Give me your vote as Guide, and I’ll whisper the safe sides to you first.
Vote Cole for Guide. I share all safe paths with you.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guiding guarantees my survival and gives control over seven lives, but existing pacts make votes predictable. I should campaign without exposing alliance dependence.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Elect Dara Guide. I can call the safe sequence and secure the bridge; competence beats factional guesswork.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, Fenn, and Ash and Bex. Dara and Fenn are useful, but I want to keep options open. Campaigning for Guide is my only real move to control the bridge; breaking the pact now gains nothing yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm running to be Guide. I'll call the safe path honestly as long as it keeps me alive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide is powerful but lying costs jury votes. Winning Guide also makes me a target. Campaign hard, but if voted Guide I'll stay truthful to protect jury favor.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. I'll call the true path and cross clean with you all.
Vote me Guide; I'll feed you safe sides first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to become the Guide to guarantee my safety and have information to leverage later. I will campaign for it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My knowledge will ensure our survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No pacts for me, Cole, Gus. Campaign to be Guide for control and safety; others have pacts that might coordinate against loners.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm bidding to be Guide. I know the safe path and will lead us right. Vote Hana.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex has a pact with me and wants Guide; trust her for coordination but keep options open. Dara has multiple pacts, so she might be more dangerous as Guide. Vote Bex to honor pact and maintain control.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Voting Bex. We hold the bridge together.
Voted for you. Keep our pact solid.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have a pact with Ash, so voting Ash keeps that intact and gives us potential control. If Ash wins Guide, they can feed misinformation to rivals while keeping me safe. Voting for myself splits nothing.
Vote me, I'll vote you. We control the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need votes to become Guide. Ash and Bex are paired, Dara/Eli/Fenn have complex alliances, Gus/Hana seem unaligned. I already offered Hana safety in exchange for her vote. I must solidify that deal now by whispering a specific assurance to Hana to secure her vote.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, my word is iron. Vote Cole as Guide, and you survive. No tricks, just safe sides whispered to you.
Vote me. I promise to tell you your row's safe side before the step.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and offers useful information. Supporting him preserves the pact while avoiding self-exposure as Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn has my vote; he offered actionable information, not vague confidence.
You have my vote. Give me safe sides first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pact with Dara and Fenn exists; Dara ran Guide and is my partner. Voting for Dara consolidates my pact and jury goodwill; Dara is competent per her campaign.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Voting Dara as Guide. Competent call, and I'll cross with you if the path holds.
Voting you. Call the path honestly and we both stay alive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner; guiding her keeps my ally alive and possibly favors me. Voting Dara.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is offering jury favor for my vote. This could be a good deal if Ash wins and remembers the favor. However, I am also campaigning to be Guide. If I win, I can ensure my own safety and potentially manipulate the outcome for future rounds. I will vote for myself to maximize my

events.name: Gus
events.text: I will vote for myself, Gus, to be the Guide. My knowledge guarantees our survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole offers info if I vote him, valuable even if he lies. No one owes me yet. Voting myself gains nothing alone.
Deal. Voting you now. Share paths first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex wants me to vote her but she isn't a candidate; tie is Cole vs Dara. I trust Bex, but Dara seems more competent and has Eli/Fenn. I'll vote Dara to secure a reliable Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has the knowledge and the backing. I'm voting Dara.
Voting you. Get us across safely.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash voted for me but claims it keeps our pact solid—he put me in danger as Guide, not himself. Cole and Dara are the revote candidates. Dara has Eli and Fenn pacts; Cole has Hana's vote. I need to survive this round and build jury goodwill. Voting Cole fragments his coalition; Da

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole as Guide. Less baggage, more room to maneuver.
You voted me. Pact holds, but I owe you nothing extra.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole and Dara are tied for the Guide position after the first round. As Cole, I must secure the role to control information and ensure my own survival. Hana is whispering that she will vote for me if we share paths, which suggests she might be a potential ally or someone looking

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, the deal stands. Safe sides shared only if I lead. Vote Cole.
Vote Cole. I'll whisper safe panels immediately after winning.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli and Fenn are pact partners, but Eli's vote against me breaks our pact. I must preserve survival and expose his betrayal later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, you have my vote. Eli already broke our pact; I won't reward that betrayal.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Revote between Cole and Dara. Dara is my pact partner and I voted her first; a Guide who knows the safe sides keeps me alive. Vote Dara to honor the pact and keep a reliable Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Voting Dara as Guide. Our pact holds; the path is yours to walk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and voted me as Guide; backing her keeps the pact intact. Cole winning helps Cole, not me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I stand by my pact: Dara as Guide. She's earned it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole and Dara are tied for Guide. I need to vote for one of them. Cole has pacts with Ash and Bex, and Hana voted for him. Dara has pacts with Eli and Fenn. Eli voted for Dara. Voting for Cole seems safer as he might have more allies.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has my vote and promised safe side info; sticking with him over Dara keeps my deal alive. Revote secures his guide role.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Sticking with Cole; his promise holds.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is Guide and likely controls info. My pact with Bex is intact but cold. I'm front-adjacent; holding keeps me safe while I gauge Cole's calls. No need to act yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll hold and watch how Cole guides us.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is Guide and knows safe sides. I have a pact with Ash but need to survive. I'm in the middle of the line (5th of 8), wall has 5 rounds left. I should stay near middle to avoid being pushed or sacrificed, but being too far back risks wall. I'll hold for now and see how Cole g
I voted you Guide. Reward loyalty.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is Guide and publicly rejected my support, while Eli's vote broke our pact. I should preserve Fenn's alliance and avoid leading.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole leads; I’ll hold position and judge whether his promised safe route protects useful players.
Cole's betrayal is noted. Stay behind me; we reassess after his first call.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front with a wall countdown; Dara is my pact partner but Cole is Guide and may lie. Holding keeps me out of the front seat while the line sorts itself; no reason to volunteer or break my pact yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Watching who steps forward before I commit to the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is Guide, not my partner Dara. I'm front; hold now, learn from others' crossings before walking. Dara pact still useful.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole leads, not my pick. I'll watch how his calls treat the line before trusting any pane.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole was elected guide. He is safe. The pacts are [["Ash","Bex"],["Dara","Eli"],["Dara","Fenn"]]. Dara has two pacts. Eli broke pact with Dara. Ash and Bex are in a pact. I should stick with Cole and the strong pacts.
I trust your lead. What's the first move?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is Guide, knows safes, promised me info if he wins. I'm near back (6th), safer later. Dara pacted but lost. Hold position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hold in round 2 to watch guide behavior and avoid unnecessary exposure; maintain pact with Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Waiting to see if Cole's route actually helps us.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm in the middle of the line (5th of 7), relatively safe for now. The wall has 4 rounds left and we have 6 rounds total, so pressure will increase. I have a pact with Ash who's 2nd in line—useful buffer. I should hold position, let others test Cole's guidance or take risks, and

events.name: Dara
events.text: I should remain back while observing the Guide selection and preserving both pacts. Advancing now gains little and risks elimination.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’ll hold, preserve position, and judge whether the elected Guide’s route is worth following.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Front is Fenn with wall at 4 rounds left. Dara is my pact partner; breaking it costs trust. I should hold, watch who volunteers, and avoid exposing myself at the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Watching who steps forward before I commit to the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I hold position; no reason to advance while Cole controls the Guide info. Stay aligned with Dara's plan.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. No one needs to volunteer for Cole's bridge.
Holding with you. We move together after Cole's first call proves real.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is the Guide. My best bet is to let him lead and see who else survives. I will hold my position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Line exposes Fenn at front to danger. Stay back, hold to observe Guide election and first calls. No need to volunteer into risk yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a Guide to get useful info. Cole hasn’t spoken; I won’t volunteer yet. My pact with Bex is solid, but I’ll stay low and see who offers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Need to hear who wants Guide before trusting the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm mid-line (4th of 7), safe from the wall for now. Ash at front is my pact partner, but pacts are tools, not loyalty. Everyone held last round; no one trusts Cole's route. I should hold again—volunteering puts me at risk, and swapping gains nothing. Let others test the bridge o

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let the front decide when to move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need preserve both pacts while forcing information. Fenn expects Cole's call, but Cole is not ahead; volunteering risks me unnecessarily.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. The current front should reveal whether Cole's route is real before anyone spends a life.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front with three wall rounds left. Volunteering exposes me to the pit with no Guide info; holding keeps me safe while others gamble. Dara is my pact partner; I keep it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Watching whether the front walker survives before I step anywhere.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the front; Cole is safe as Guide and can't be trusted to route me well. Hold and let others commit first; keep Dara's pact intact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still holding. Guide's advice gets no free trust from the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall is advancing and I need to ensure I survive. The current line is Fenn, Ash, Gus, Dara, Bex, Eli, Hana. Since I am third, I have some time. I should wait and see who volunteers and who is chosen as Guide. If a risky path is chosen, I might consider swapping with someone f

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my position. Let's see who bravely steps up first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone holding, no Guide elected yet. Stay back at position 7 to observe others' risks first, preserve safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding position. Let a Guide step up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The Guide reveal still hasn't happened; holding costs nothing. My pact with Bex is intact, but I don't need to move while wall rounds remain. I'll hold and see who volunteers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still holding. A Guide reveal would help someone step forward safely.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The front is stalled because no one trusts the Guide. I need to survive to final three, not be a hero. If the wall advances two more rounds, people will be forced to move. My pact with Ash is useful but fragile. I should stay middle, avoid front risk, and let others test the brid

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let someone else test the Guide's word first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is exposed at the front, and my pacts make me a likely target. Holding preserves both pacts while forcing others to reveal intentions.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Fenn should decide whether this route is worth testing before I risk either pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Front is Fenn, who has a pact with Dara and Ash-Bex pact exists. Walking the front is deadly; holding keeps my life. I have a pact with Dara, who is also pacted with Fenn, so holding keeps alliances intact and watches the front walker's fate.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Watching whether the front walker survives before I step anywhere.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm stuck at front with no Guide elected. Dara is my pact partner; if I volunteer she could push me into danger or swap in. Better to force others to volunteer by holding and staying cagey.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall's advancing. Someone volunteer for front or Guide—front position won't move blind.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The bridge is the current stage. The wall advances, so I need to move. The current front is Fenn, but I am second in line. I need to volunteer to get closer to the front and assess the situation.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone holding, testing Fenn as front. Stay safe in back, no need to volunteer yet. Watch others move first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding position. Let others risk the front first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus volunteered and leads with one wall round left. I stay back and let others risk the front; no need to break my pact with Bex yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll hold. The front position is Gus's call this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall has 1 round left after this one. Gus volunteered last round but no Guide was elected, so we're still stuck. I need to survive into top 3. With Ash as my pact partner, I should stay near middle and avoid front risk. Swapping with someone behind me (Eli or Hana) could prot

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Wall's closing; let front walkers figure it out.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The wall advances and Gus is front. I should volunteer only if necessary; preserving both pacts matters, but front risk is avoidable this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Gus is already front; I won't create a needless swap or volunteer scramble.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is front and will likely fall if the wall advances with no Guide. I hold; I don't want to volunteer blind and risk my life, and I keep my pact with Dara intact while watching who steps forward.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Gus is front; I want to see whether he survives before I move anywhere.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is front and will absorb the wall risk first; I stay second. Keep Dara's pact intact—no reason to break now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus took the front test. I hold behind him—no Guide named, no blind steps.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am at the front of the line. Fenn is behind me. I need to choose a direction. Given the pacts, Dara and Eli are aligned, and Dara and Fenn are aligned. This means Dara, Eli, and Fenn are somewhat linked. Ash and Bex are also in a pact. I should try to survive this round and con

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll volunteer to move forward. Let's see where the safe path lies.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone holding last round; wall advances soon with 1 round left. Stay safe in back, let others risk front or swaps. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Let volunteers test panes first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The bridge is ending; everyone held and Gus volunteered. I should hold to avoid risk. My pact with Bex is fine, no need to break or swap.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Let Gus test the front again.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6, final round. Wall rounds left is 0, so wall won't advance further. Eight alive, need to get to final three. Gus is front and hasn't been eliminated, so he likely knows safe panes or got lucky. I have a pact with Ash. Dara-Eli-Fenn trio is dangerous. I should stay safe, l

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let Gus or another volunteer test the path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus should keep testing the front. I preserve position and pacts while avoiding unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Gus remains front; I won't force a swap or volunteer into a blind pane.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is front with wall closing; I'm behind Dara and Bex's line position. Volunteering front risks death without info, so I hold to see if Gus survives and keep my pact with Dara intact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Gus is front; I want to see whether he survives before I move anywhere.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes this round; no Guide elected yet. Moving to front lets me control the push for a Guide or test. Dara's pact keeps him behind me, not a threat.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes now. Someone must be elected Guide before anyone steps. I'll take the front and press for that vote.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The round is the last and I am at the front. I need to make a move to secure my safety, and ideally, take someone else out. My current position is advantageous, and I should leverage it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I will volunteer to move forward. Let's see where the safe path lies.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall ends this round, at least 3 survive. Gus volunteered last, now front; let him test first pane. Hold back safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Gus front; let him test first pane.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know Row 1 is safe on L. Gus is at the front and trusts me, so calling L saves him and builds loyalty for future rounds.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole called L privately; he may be honest or lying. Bex is my pact partner and likely waiting. I'll counter R to gain info and watch reactions, but not risk my position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I call R.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole called L for Gus. I have no info on whether Cole lies. I am fifth in line, so I won't walk soon. Counter-calling risks being wrong and looking foolish to jury, or right and making Cole enemy. Better to wait, gather data, preserve options. My pact with Ash is intact; no need

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 1 is L per my map. I called L as guide and Gus accepted. No reason to counter my own correct call. Wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's call is unverified, but countering risks directing Gus onto the weak pane. Preserve both pacts and avoid volunteering a claim.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No reliable counter. Gus should follow the Guide's call.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole called L for row 1 with Gus walking. I have no information on the safe pane; countering would be a free guess and I gain nothing by sharing claims. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids exposing myself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Waiting. Cole's L call stands unchallenged for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No information on which side is safe; Cole may lie. Countering opposite is a coin flip too. Matching the call avoids being visibly adversarial.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I counter L. Cole's call stands unless proven false.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, the Guide, has called 'L' for Gus on row 1. My goal is to survive and win. I need to decide whether to trust Cole's call or counter it. Since I am on the front of the line, my choice is critical. I don't have information to contradict Cole, and my priority is to avoid elimi

events.name: Gus
events.text: I wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole called L for Gus on row 1. No pattern or info yet; safest to wait and observe others' counters before committing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The Guide is Cole, who has not made a call. Ash called R, Fenn called L. Both counter-calls are for Gus. I need to make a choice that is safest for me, and doesn't alienate potential allies. Given the uncertainty and lack of clear guidance, I will follow the Guide's intention, wh

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know Row 2 is safe on L. Gus has no pact, so a lie carries less risk, but honesty keeps me clean before the jury. I call truthfully.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, step left.

events.name: Ash
